message.text: The component has been identified. Now examining server.go to locate the exact wiring site and line numbers.

I have identified the answer.

`s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` refreshes S3 attachment presigned URLs. It runs every 12 hours. It is started in `startBackgroundRunners()` inside `server/server.go` around line 129.

The exact wiring site is `server/server.go:129`, where `Start()` invokes `startBackgroundRunners()`.

It also runs once immediately on startup at line 163 before the 12-hour ticker begins.

The server startup wiring begins at main.go:89, where s.Start(ctx) is called.

s.Start(ctx) delegates to server.go:129, which invokes startBackgroundRunners(ctx). That function wires the s3presign runner at server.go:162–169.

The runner is `s3presign.Runner`, scheduled every 12 hours, and wired at `server/server.go:129`.

The runner also executes once immediately on startup via RunOnce, then repeats every 12 hours. The interval is defined by the runnerInterval constant.

The wiring site is server/server.go:162, where the s3presign runner is instantiated and connected to the store.
